message.reasoning_content:
We need to classify relation between two yes/no questions.

Q1: "O bem-estar animal deve ser considerado um componente essencial da sustentabilidade na produção de alimentos de origem animal?" This asks whether animal welfare should be considered an essential component of sustainability in animal food production.

Q2: "O Brasil deve avançar nas políticas de bem-estar animal para atender a compromissos internacionais e à demanda da sociedade?" This asks whether Brazil should advance animal welfare policies to meet international commitments and societal demand.

Are they same issue? Q1 is about conceptual inclusion of animal welfare as essential component of sustainability. Q2 is about policy advancement in Brazil for commitments/demand. Different scope: one is conceptual/definition, other is policy action in a specific country. So DIFFERENT.

Not opposite polarity. Not equivalent. Not uncertain.

Thus answer: relation DIFFERENT, reasoning: they address different questions (conceptual vs policy).
